title: Minecraft Bone Meal Farm Tutorial - NEW & FAST - 16,000 P/H!
description:
In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the NEW High Speed & Super Efficient [V1] Bone Meal Farm That Is simply Based On Moss Blocks and is self-sustaining! In Minecraft

📚This Bonemeal Farm is so fast and can produce +16,000 Bonemeals Per Hour! but let me say that it might be affected on some servers because of the limitations that they applied 
📚This bonemeal farm is self-sustaining!
📚It's so easy to build you can build this farm only in 1 ~ 3 hours!
📚Unfortunately because of some game mechanics, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
